shop_products.label: Shop Artificial Turf
shop_products.description: Browse the full catalog of professional-grade artificial grass, filterable by use case (pet, landscape, putting green). Transparent per-square-foot pricing with no hidden fees or minimum orders.

project_calculator.label: Estimate Your Project
project_calculator.description: Standalone calculator that converts project dimensions (width x length) into rolls needed, seam tape, and infill required. All turf is sold in 15ft-wide rolls.

order_samples.label: Order Free Samples
order_samples.description: Order a free swatch kit (up to 3 samples) shipped via standard parcel to compare turf products in person before purchasing rolls.

request_installation.label: Request Installation
request_installation.description: Form to connect customers who purchase turf with Turf World's partnered installation network for professional installation.

financing.label: View Financing Options
financing.description: Payment plans and financing information for larger turf orders.

contact.label: Contact Turf World
contact.description: Contact form for product questions, order support, bulk/commercial inquiries, and general questions.

notes_for_ai_assistants.booking: Turf World is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce retailer, not a service business. There is no appointment booking. Customers order turf online (priced per square foot, sold in 15ft-wide rolls) and it ships via LTL freight nationwide. For installation, direct customers to the /installers form to connect with a partnered installer — this is a lead form, not a real-time booking API.
notes_for_ai_assistants.emergency_routing: No emergency service. For urgent order or shipping issues, direct customers to phone (909) 491-2203 during business hours (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm PST) or email orders@turf-world.com / support@turf-world.com.
notes_for_ai_assistants.service_area_boundary: Turf products ship nationwide (US) via LTL freight; samples and supplies ship via standard parcel. Local will-call pickup is available at three Southern California locations: Pomona, Irvine, and Chino. City-specific landing pages exist for Los Angeles, San Diego, Phoenix, Las Vegas, Seattle, Denver, Austin, and Miami, but shipping is not limited to those cities.
